Use `snl migrate` only when `snl info` shows that the workspace needs an explicit schema migration.

### Agent procedure
1. Require a clean version-controlled workspace or a user-approved backup before migration.
2. Set the target with `--to <schema-version>` and never emulate migration through manual JSON edits.
3. Read the migration report, rerun `snl info`, and require `snl validate` to pass before any further authoring.
4. Run `snl validate --root <path> --json` after the write and stop if it reports an error.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl migrate` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
